AnalysisInput.title: AnalysisInput
AnalysisInput.description:
Monthly or interval research. Years are this year plus ``historical_years``
complete past years; an interval end before its start crosses the year end.

AnalysisRefreshOutput.title: AnalysisRefreshOutput
AnalysisRefreshOutput.description: Command receipt shared by native and custom-event research kinds.

BrowserRefresh.title: BrowserRefresh
BrowserRefresh.description: How often an open page re-reads and asks for fresh data (config/refresh.toml).

CompanySection.title: CompanySection
CompanySection.description: The first rows of one list, its full count and the trades left out of its amounts.

DateAnomaly.title: DateAnomaly
DateAnomaly.description: Transaction dated after its own SEC acceptance date; kept as reported.

EntityHistoryOutput.title: EntityHistoryOutput
EntityHistoryOutput.description: A company's or person's transactions in a stable reading session.

index.title: Index
index.description: 1-based position in events; null for the whole document

reaction_date.title: Reaction Date
reaction_date.description: Reaction day R; null outside the exchange calendar

EventReactionCandle.title: EventReactionCandle
EventReactionCandle.description: The reaction day relative to C(R-1): open is the gap, close the reaction.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: ^GSPC, ^IXIC or an ETF; null for no comparison

up_low.title: Up Low
up_low.description: Wilson 95% interval of the up share

beat.title: Beat
beat.description: Events whose change exceeded the benchmark's

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: before, reaction, gap and after windows

EventVariantInput.title: EventVariantInput
EventVariantInput.description: Another n and/or benchmark for the same frozen events; omitted fields keep theirs.

value.title: Value
value.description: Decimal ratio, e.g. -0.0123; null when pending or missing

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: The benchmark's change over the same dates

FeedGroup.title: FeedGroup
FeedGroup.description: One company and SEC acceptance date (US Eastern), as of one revision.

FeedGroupOutput.title: FeedGroupOutput
FeedGroupOutput.description: Either trader groups (cursor "g:…") or transaction rows of one group.

HomeQuote.title: HomeQuote
HomeQuote.description:
One index (or gold futures) quote as saved from its latest fetch.

``freshness`` is judged at read time: ``live`` in session and on time,
``closed`` outside the session (``as_of`` is the last trading day),
``delayed`` when overdue, stale at the source or the last refresh failed
(``reason`` says which), ``missing`` before the first fetch.

InsiderOwner.title: InsiderOwner
InsiderOwner.description: A reporting owner with the roles stated in that filing.

InsiderTransaction.title: InsiderTransaction
InsiderTransaction.description: One row of Table I or II of a Form 3/4/5 filing.

JobSummary.title: JobSummary
JobSummary.description: List row: scalar fields only; checkpoint/result/target stay in the detail.

MarketChart.title: MarketChart
MarketChart.description:
Where the daily bars come from: ``history`` (the six-month fetch, 24 hours),
``cache`` (a cached price range), ``quote`` (the quote's last 40 days) or none.

MarketHistoryState.title: MarketHistoryState
MarketHistoryState.description: ``missing``: the page should ask for six months; ``fetching``; ``failed`` today; ``fresh``.

PendingSummary.title: PendingSummary
PendingSummary.description: Filings seen at SEC but not yet parsed, by stage.

PeriodStats.title: PeriodStats
PeriodStats.description: Complete past years only; ``target_n`` is how many were asked for.

PriceContext.title: PriceContext
PriceContext.description: Price change around a transaction; status explains when it is unavailable.

PriceWindow.title: PriceWindow
PriceWindow.description: Closes from t−n to t+n around one time basis (transaction or disclosure).

SearchOutput.title: SearchOutput
SearchOutput.description: Local matches only; searching never starts a download.

SecContactOutput.title: SecContactOutput
SecContactOutput.description: SEC contact for the User-Agent; ``config_file`` (deploy/.env) wins and is read-only here.

SideTotal.title: SideTotal
SideTotal.description: Open-market purchases (buy) or sales (sell) in the range: owners, shares, known amount.

StorageState.title: StorageState
StorageState.description: Recorded sizes (no directory walk); capacity verdicts are null when unknown.

TickerProgress.title: TickerProgress
TickerProgress.description: One ticker's step: download prices → compute → done (or failed / waiting).

TradeSummary.title: TradeSummary
TradeSummary.description: Rows of one action (table, security, currency, code) added up.

TraderGroup.title: TraderGroup
TraderGroup.description: The same owners, transaction date and action inside one company/date group.

WorkerState.title: WorkerState
WorkerState.description: Worker liveness from its heartbeat; online is null when the read failed.
